description: This file defines the StreamingWrite interface for streaming data source writes in Apache Spark, including methods for creating writer factories, committing, and aborting write jobs.

classes.name: StreamingWrite
classes.description: An interface that defines how to write data to a data source in streaming queries, including methods for creating writer factories, committing, and aborting.

methods.name: createStreamingWriterFactory
methods.description: Creates a serialized writer factory for executors based on physical write info.

methods.name: useCommitCoordinator
methods.description: Indicates whether to use the commit coordinator to ensure at most one task per partition commits.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the write job for a specific epoch with collected commit messages.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the write job for a specific epoch, used when failures occur.
